title: [2.8] Setup Wizard fails to import configuration
body:
I switched phones yesterday and did a fresh install of AndroidAPS 2.8 but copied the config files, too. When the Setup Wizard offered to import my settings, I pressed the button to open the dialogue but nothing happened. Another person on Discord reported the same problem. The person and I had no problem importing the config by using the usual maintenance dialogue.


System:
AndroidAPS 2.8
Medtronic 554
Dexcom G6
xDrip+
Oneplus 3T
Lineage 17.1

comments.body: on some phones it's necessary to restart aaps to apply storage permission
I didn't restart AndroidAPS. I quit the wizard and went straight to the maintenance dialogue.
then restart of activity is enough
Sorry, I'm not following. Could you repeat yourself in more layman terms?

Had the same issue. Import settings while installing didn't import the saved settings. I'm not 100% sure that I restarted the app after the permissions but I think I did restart. 
I had to quit the creation of a new profile and imported through the classical maintenance menu and it worked.
